answer_1.quote: We fine-tune GPT-2 three times each time on a different random subset containing 3K articles, 1K of them shared across subsets, from the CNN-DM dataset for 10 epochs with a batch size of 16, a learning rate of 0.001, and no weight decay.

answer_2.quote: We also compute the Average Likelihood Ratio (ALR) for each dataset to measure memorization... Table 2 presents the ALR and perplexity scores for the base model, three fine-tuned models, the fused model and full model fine-tuned on combined data.
